title: PlanRecoveryResponse
description: Persisted recovery batch, selected ordinary detail Reminders, frozen Anniversary catch-up groups, and immutable arbitration for attempts prepared before recovery. detail_reminders exactly matches batch.detail_reminder_ids. Anniversary membership is read only from batch.anniversary_catch_up_groups. Habit Reminder and Notification identities never appear here.
x-recovery-selection-order: Force ring candidates with remind_at < batch.started_at minus 5 minutes into summary.
Sort all remaining detail-eligible candidates by remind_at descending then reminder_id descending and select at most 20.
Sort selected details and all summary members by remind_at ascending then reminder_id ascending for delivery.
detail_reminders exactly matches batch.detail_reminder_ids in order.

anniversary_catch_up_groups.description: Exact copy of batch.anniversary_catch_up_groups in the same order; Kotlin must not regroup or add members.
